title: Hideout monthly specials
service: Menu design, typography, bilingual layout, AI-assisted image editing
intro: A new specials menu every month for an international bar in Busan. One visual voice, a different theme each month, in two languages.
brief: Hideout's owners create new signature cocktails every month, each time around a different theme: a flavour, a mood or a technique. Every menu needs an English and a Korean version, and each month has to feel distinct while clearly belonging to the same bar.
did: I built the series around a fixed core: the same structure, type hierarchy and way of presenting each drink, so guests always know where to look. Everything around it shifts to bring that month's theme forward.
Each menu is then laid out twice. Korean and English differ a lot in length and rhythm, so each version is rebalanced instead of just translated in place.
There's no budget for a studio shoot every month, so the drinks are photographed on a phone at the bar, then reworked in Photoshop with AI-assisted editing until they hold up as menu imagery.
